organization: University of Science and Technology of China

details.text: Trained unified multimodal embedding models for image, video and visual-document retrieval on MMEB v2.
Built a unified data, training and evaluation pipeline; explored hard-negative mining, multi-source training and model ensembling on 16 NVIDIA A100 GPUs.

details.label: Research
details.text: Worked on reasoning-chain compression, self-distilled latent tools and uncertainty-guided token-level model routing.

details.label: Publications
details.text: Co-authored ThinkLeap and STIR (EMNLP 2026), and TokenRouter (Findings of EMNLP 2026).
